notes.title: Demo ends soon (February 26)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everybody![/b]

We just wanted to take a moment to let you know that the demo will be ending on February 26. We will focus our attention on developing the full version. The demo will be back in an updated and improved form in a few weeks!

If you haven't yet, please be sure to wishlist the game to keep updated as we announce more details on upcoming plans.

Many thanks to everyone who sent feedback on the demo, a lot has been improved with your help.

[i]See you soon![/i]
